name: Logistics

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: LOGISTICS: Strong volume growth and price hikes drive revenue growth and EBITDA margin expansion
mofsl_2qfy27.read: Coverage (ex APSEZ and JSWINFRA) revenue grew ~15% YoY on healthy volumes and price hikes to offset fuel and wage costs; EBITDA margin rose 80bp YoY (130bp QoQ) to 12.2%. VRL volume grew 11% despite 9% price hikes, APSEZ cargo volume rose 15% with EBITDA margin 60.0%, JSWINFRA cargo grew 2% with margin 45.5%. APSEZ revised FY27 revenue/EBITDA guidance to INR440-460b/INR260-270b and JSWINFRA to INR66b/INR30b; CONCOR gave no FY27 guidance. Top picks: APSEZ and Delhivery.

unit_economics: Express: EBITDA = shipments x (realisation - cost per shipment) - corporate overheads; PTL/trucking = tonnes x (Rs/kg - cost) driven by utilisation; ports = cargo tonnes x tariff with high fixed-cost leverage; rail/CFS = TEUs x (rate - haul cost)

price_drivers.why: Delhivery guides 20-30% express and 20%+ PTL volume growth; VRL guides 9-10% in 2HFY27; port cargo growth is the key top line for APSEZ.

price_drivers.driver: Realisation and price hikes vs fuel and wages
price_drivers.why: 9% price hikes at VRL and fuel surcharges recovered diesel and wage costs, lifting EBITDA margin 80bp.
Diesel is ~25% of VRL revenue and Delhivery's labour cost is exposed to state minimum-wage rounds; pass-through lags 1-2 quarters.
CONCOR withheld FY27 guidance until December as geopolitics and normalisation of global shipping routes remain uncertain; JSWINFRA lost Fujairah volumes.
Delhivery targets 130-150bp transport EBITDA margin expansion; truck fill and sorter utilisation drive margin.

kpis.name: Volume growth (shipments, tonnes, cargo, TEUs)
kpis.definition: Growth in shipments (express), tonnage (PTL/LTL), cargo tonnes (ports) or TEUs (rail/CFS)
kpis.formula: reported; organic = excluding acquired volumes for four quarters
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Volume growth drives operating leverage: VRL +11%, APSEZ cargo +15%, JSWINFRA +2%; Delhivery's Ecom Express acquisition distorts reported growth until Q3FY27.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation 'volume', 'shipments' or 'cargo' metric filters; transcripts; Motilal Oswal results update tables (8 quarters)
kpis.estimate_source: No Bloomberg volume field; company volume guidance (DELHIVERY 20-30%, VRL 9-10%, TCIEXP 11-12%) and broker models; get_consensus_estimates for Sales/EBITDA/PAT/EPS only
kpis.traps: Delhivery counts RTO with forward shipment; Ecom Express acquisition inflates growth; port cargo mix (container vs bulk) differs; TEU vs tonnes.

kpis.name: Realisation per shipment / per kg / per tonne
kpis.definition: Revenue per shipment (express), per kg (PTL), per tonne (VRL) or tariff per tonne (ports), ex fuel where disclosed
kpis.why_it_moves_price: VRL realisation is guided stable at ~INR8,800/ton; Delhivery's realisation has fallen from Rs70.7 to ~Rs58 on lighter parcels, so the split of price vs mix decides whether margin holds.
kpis.history_source: Derive from get_financials revenue and volume from get_investor_presentation; transcripts; Motilal Oswal tables
kpis.estimate_source: Management realisation guidance on calls (VRL INR8,800/ton); broker models; no consensus
kpis.traps: Mix (weight slab, COD) vs like-for-like price; fuel surcharge inside revenue; Ind AS 115 in-transit deferral.

kpis.name: EBITDA margin (house core, pre-Ind AS 116)
kpis.definition: EBITDA ex other income, after cash lease payments, excluding one-offs
kpis.formula: (reported EBITDA - lease cash payments + one-offs inside EBITDA) / revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Coverage EBITDA margin rose to 12.2% (+80bp YoY); Delhivery guides transport margin up 130-150bp, TCIEXP 50-100bp for FY27; price hikes and volume leverage are the drivers.
kpis.history_source: get_financials 5+ years; Motilal Oswal results tables; Delhivery shareholder-letter margin lines via get_investor_presentation
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates Bloomberg EBITDA FY27-FY29; company margin guidance (APSEZ EBITDA INR260-270b, JSWINFRA INR30b)
kpis.traps: Delhivery has five EBITDA bases (service, company adjusted, reported); TCIEXP and VRL decks include other income; Blue Dart standalone vs consolidated; ESOP add-backs.

kpis.name: Service EBITDA per shipment / per tonne
kpis.definition: Line-level EBITDA before corporate overheads per shipment (express) or per tonne (PTL)
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Per-parcel profit stays near Rs11 at Delhivery even as realisation falls, which separates mix from price; falling per-unit profit signals price competition.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation (Delhivery decks: service EBITDA, shipments); get_financials revenue; transcripts
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models (Motilal Oswal, Kotak) and management margin range (express 16-18%); no consensus
kpis.traps: Shared network cost allocation between Express and PTL is discretionary; segment reporting is management-defined.

kpis.name: Network utilisation and truck fill
kpis.definition: Share of capacity filled across trucks, hubs and sorters
kpis.why_it_moves_price: At TCIEXP +1pp truck fill is worth ~+100bp margin; VRL volume recovery after hikes lifts fill and operating leverage.
kpis.history_source: Transcripts and get_qa (call-only disclosure); get_investor_presentation utilisation filter
kpis.estimate_source: Management commentary and broker models; no consensus
kpis.traps: Delhivery declines to disclose utilisation; rated vs effective capacity.

kpis.name: Port cargo mix and EBITDA margin per tonne
kpis.definition: Cargo by type (container, dry bulk, liquid) and port EBITDA margin or EBITDA per tonne
kpis.formula: port EBITDA / cargo tonnes; EBITDA margin (APSEZ 60.0%, JSWINFRA 45.5%)
kpis.why_it_moves_price: APSEZ margin was 60.0% (-50bp YoY) and JSWINFRA 45.5% (-260bp YoY); international volumes and cargo mix shift margin.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates Bloomberg EBITDA; company guidance (APSEZ INR260-270b, JSWINFRA INR30b, India cargo growth 8-10% in 2H)
kpis.traps: APSEZ includes logistics and marine segments with lower margins; Fujairah volumes at JSWINFRA.

kpis.name: CFS and rail: EXIM and domestic TEU volumes
kpis.definition: Container volumes split EXIM and domestic, and rail terminal throughput
kpis.formula: reported TEUs / tonnes; revenue per TEU
kpis.why_it_moves_price: CONCOR targets ~INR150b revenue by FY29 with EXIM ~15% and domestic ~20% CAGR; global shipping routes drive near-term volumes.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation TEU/volume filters; transcripts; Motilal Oswal results tables
kpis.estimate_source: Management CAGR targets and broker models; consensus Sales/EBITDA only
kpis.traps: Haulage tariffs and land licence fee; no FY27 guidance given.

kpis.name: Fuel and wage cost pass-through (cost per unit)
kpis.definition: Diesel, labour and line-haul cost per shipment or per tonne against price actions and fuel surcharge
kpis.formula: cost per unit / realisation; fuel % of revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Delhivery's EBITDA missed consensus by 23-31% in Q1FY27 on fuel and wages; MOFSL notes price hikes and surcharges were needed to offset higher fuel costs and labour wages.
kpis.history_source: get_financials expense lines (freight, employee, power and fuel); transcripts for surcharge timing
kpis.estimate_source: Management cost commentary and broker models; get_commodity_prices for crude as proxy
kpis.traps: Fuel clauses reprice with 10-15 day to 1 month lag; state minimum-wage notifications hit within the quarter.
